baglietto_cessation_ref.finding: Smoking-driven CpGs decay toward never-smoker values over 5-10 years post-cessation.

strata.specificity_concern: A current smoker without cancer also shows elevated A_immune from smoking alone. Card cannot distinguish smoking-only from smoking+cancer at Stage 1; Stage 2 Moss localization to lung_epithelial is required.
strata.deployment_rule: Report must include smoking-adjustment context sentence. Lung-epic fires only if Stage 2 ΔA at lung_epithelial exceeds 2× all other tissues (not just DETECTABLE tier at Stage 1).

expected_A_immune_sources: typically EGFR-mutant adenocarcinoma (more common in women, East Asian populations)
strata.expected_magnitude: moderate — cancer signal only, cleaner interpretation
strata.specificity_concern: Never-smoker NSCLC methylation signature is less well characterized than smoker signature. Hong 2019 found NO genome-wide significant DMPs in nonsmoker Korean NSCLC cohort, though per-CpG directional analysis would likely recover signal.
strata.deployment_rule: Report is cleaner — no smoking confound. But if A_immune elevation is subtle, Stage 2 localization is essential. Consider EGFR mutation testing at early workup if Stage 2 top-1 is lung_epithelial.

expected_A_immune_sources: residual smoking signature (decays over years post-quit)
strata.specificity_concern: Time-since-quit strongly modifies signature. Baglietto 2017 showed smoking-driven CpGs recover toward never-smoker values over 5-10 years post-cessation.
strata.deployment_rule: Report must include years-since-quit. If >10 years quit, treat interpretation as closer to never-smoker; if <5 years, closer to current smoker.

tier_rationale: 4/4 predictions pass. Kadota 2014 confirms lung field effect extends 5-10 cm beyond tumor margin. Moss 2018 confirms Stage 2 tissue-of-origin localization. TCGA-LUAD/LUSC confirms crystallized-cancer magnitude. Per-patient blood methylation pre-diagnostic validation remains pending (UK Biobank / CLUE II / MCCS access).

what_this_anchors_for_lung_epic_v0_2.stage_2_localization: CONFIRMED — VAL-041 Moss 2018 Fig 4b: lung_epithelial top-1 with ΔA = +0.14304, confidence ratio 60.87× top-2.
what_this_anchors_for_lung_epic_v0_2.lung_tissue_field_effect: CONFIRMED — VAL-039 / Kadota 2014 lung adenocarcinoma distance gradient, n=152 total samples. Tumor ΔA = +0.15150, far-adjacent (≥5 cm) ΔA = +0.01702.
what_this_anchors_for_lung_epic_v0_2.crystallized_cancer_magnitude: CONFIRMED — TCGA-LUAD tumor ΔA = +0.16494, TCGA-LUSC tumor ΔA = +0.16144. Both exceed +0.10 crystallized tier.
what_this_anchors_for_lung_epic_v0_2.stage_1_per_patient_blood_pre_diagnostic: PENDING — no public blood methylation cohort with n ≥ 100 lung cases and TtD metadata is accessible as of 2026-04-24. Candidates: UK Biobank (TODO 8.2), CLUE II (direct PI contact), MCCS (EGA phs003213 application).
what_this_anchors_for_lung_epic_v0_2.smoker_never_smoker_stratification: LITERATURE-DOCUMENTED — Hong 2019 Korean NSCLC n=150+150 shows cg12169243 DPH6 and cg25429010 IMP3 reach genome-wide significance in current smokers only. Card v0.2 specifies mandatory smoking covariate reporting and separate clinical action paths per smoking stratum.
